verdict.rationale: Digits explicitly generates P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements on demand from its live AGL ledger, with API endpoints for 'Generate a balance sheet statement', cash flow, and P&L, plus dashboards and custom reports (help.digits.com custom report doc). Pricing page confirms 'real-time financial statements—profit & loss, balance sheet, and cash flow' updating automatically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of statement accuracy for arbitrary custom periods, and no third-party review confirming report correctness beyond vendor claims.
